title: Richard Dolan: men in black as NHI counterintelligence

plain: The men in black, figures said to visit and frighten people who have seen UFOs, may be a kind of counterintelligence working on behalf of non-human intelligence, meaning the aliens themselves, according to the researcher Richard Dolan. Michels passes on Dolan's view in his own words. If true, it would mean these visitors protect the aliens' secrets rather than any government's.
